# @useinvio/nfse-sdk

> TypeScript SDK for Brazil's NFS-e Nacional (SEFIN/ADN). It issues, queries and cancels national service invoices: builds the DPS from JSON, validates it against the official XSD, signs it (XMLDSIG), sends it over mTLS with an ICP-Brasil A1 certificate, and returns SEFIN's answer as typed results and typed errors. It is not a tax engine: service codes, regime, tax blocks and DPS numbering always come from the user.

This file is for AI assistants writing code that uses the package. To change the SDK itself, read `AGENTS.md` in the repository.

## Install and certificate

```bash
npm install @useinvio/nfse-sdk   # Node.js >= 20, ESM, no native binaries
```

```ts
import { NfseCertificate } from '@useinvio/nfse-sdk';
const certificado = NfseCertificate.fromEnv(); // NFSE_CERT_PATH or NFSE_CERT_BASE64, plus NFSE_CERT_PASSWORD or NFSE_CERT_PASSWORD_FILE
```

`NfseCertificate` keeps the private key out of the object; `console.log` and `JSON.stringify` show only CNPJ/CPF, validity and fingerprint. Never log, commit or ask for the `.pfx` or its password. Other loaders: `fromFile(path, pwd)`, `fromBase64(b64, pwd)`, `fromPfx(buffer, pwd)`, `fromPem({ key, cert })`. Errors: `CertificateValidationError` with `code` (`CERTIFICATE_INVALID_PASSWORD`, `CERTIFICATE_EXPIRED`, ...).

## Issue

```ts
import { emitirNfse, EmitirNotaError, explicarErros, type DpsJsonRequest } from '@useinvio/nfse-sdk';

const nota: DpsJsonRequest = {
  ambiente: 'restrita', // official sandbox; 'producao' is legally valid
  prestador: { cnpj, cLocEmi, serie, opSimpNac, regEspTrib },
  servico: { cTribNac, xDescServ, cLocPrestacao },
  emissao: { nDPS, valores: { vServ: '1500.00' }, tributacaoMunicipal, tributacaoFederal, totTrib },
};
try {
  const { chaveAcesso, dpsId, nfseXml } = await emitirNfse(nota, certificado);
} catch (error) {
  if (error instanceof EmitirNotaError) console.table(explicarErros(error.erros)); // official rule per code
  else throw error; // network/timeout: the outcome is unknown, see "Recover"
}
```

- Keep fiscal codes and amounts as strings (leading zeros matter). Do not invent `cTribNac`, IBGE codes, regime or tax blocks; ask the user. Field reference: `JSON_MAPPING.md`.
- Validate without sending: `validateDpsJsonRequest(nota)` returns `{ valid, issues, warnings }`; `buildDpsFromJson(nota)` returns `{ id, xml }`.
- Persist before sending: `const p = prepararNota(nota, cert)` then `transmitirNotaPreparada(p, cert)`.
- Each `nDPS` (with `serie`) produces one invoice; increment it after a successful emission.

## Recover after a timeout (never resend blindly)

```ts
const existing = await recuperarNfsePorDps(p.dpsId, certificado, p.ambiente, { retries: 3 });
// existing !== null: it was issued. null: SEFIN never got it; resend the SAME prepared DPS.
```

POST requests (emission, events) are never retried by the SDK. `{ timeoutMs, retries, signal }` works on every call; `retries` applies to GETs only.

## Query, PDF, cancel

```ts
const { nfseXml, resumo } = await obterNfse(chaveAcesso, certificado); // ConsultaNfseError, .notFound on 404
const { pdf } = await baixarDanfse(chaveAcesso, certificado);
await cancelarNfse({ chaveAcesso, cMotivo: '1', xMotivo: 'Nota emitida com valor incorreto' }, certificado); // RegistrarEventoError
await cancelarNfsePorSubstituicao({ chaveAcesso, chaveSubstituta, cMotivo: '01' }, certificado);
```

`cMotivo` for cancellation: `1` issuing error, `2` service not provided, `9` other; `xMotivo` 15 to 255 characters. `lerNfse(xml)` reads an NFS-e XML you already have. ADN: `distribuirDfePorNsu`, `consultarConvenio`, `consultarAliquota`, `consultarRetencoes`.

## Client

```ts
const client = new NfseClient({ environment: 'sandbox', certificate: certificado, defaults: { prestador, servico }, request: { timeoutMs: 30_000, retries: 2 } });
await client.invoices.create({ emissao });          // also retrieve, recover, cancel, cancelBySubstitution, danfse
```

## Rejection codes

`explicarRejeicao('E0014')` returns the official message, rule and XML field from the gov.br annexes (Anexo I v1.01, Anexo II v1.01), `conhecida: false` for codes not in the catalog. `explicarErros(error.erros)` explains a whole rejection.

## Tests without a certificate or network

```ts
import { createTestCertificate, installMockSefin } from '@useinvio/nfse-sdk/testing';
const mock = installMockSefin();                    // in-process SEFIN + ADN; validates XSD and signatures
const { certificate } = createTestCertificate({ cnpj: '12345678000195' });
// ... emitirNfse / obterNfse / cancelarNfse work as usual ...
mock.rejectNext('E0312'); mock.dropResponseNext(); // script rejections and dropped connections
mock.restore();
```

## AI agents and MCP

- `npx -y @useinvio/nfse-mcp`: MCP stdio server. Env: certificate vars above, `NFSE_AMBIENTE`, `NFSE_MCP_ALLOW_WRITE=1` (emit/cancel), `NFSE_MCP_MOCK=1` (mock SEFIN).
- `@useinvio/nfse-sdk/agent`: `nfseAgentTools` (read-only: `validate_dps`, `build_dps_xml`, `get_nfse`, `recover_nfse_by_dps`, `explain_rejection`) and `createNfseAgentToolkit({ allowWrite })`, which adds `prepare_*`/`confirm_*` emission and cancellation. Certificate and environment are host context, never tool input. Only call `confirm_*` after the user approves the summary from `prepare_*`.
- Claude Code plugin: `/plugin install nfse-nacional --marketplace useinvio/nfse-sdk`.

## Docs

- `docs/README.md` (pt-BR): tutorial, guides, API and error reference.
- `docs/referencia/erros.md`: every error class and code.
- `docs/referencia/ambientes.md`: SEFIN and ADN URLs and endpoints.
